```{r, echo=FALSE}
img_features <- function(path, thr = 0.05) {
  print("action")
  nms    <- c("avg_R", "avg_G", "avg_B", "bright_prop")
  na_out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(nms)), nms)
  if (is.na(path)) return(na_out)

  img    <- resize(load.image(path))
  retina <- grayscale(img) > thr            # field of view (non-black)
  if (!any(retina)) return(na_out)

  rm <- R(img)[retina]
  gm <- G(img)[retina]
  bm <- B(img)[retina]

  c(avg_R       = mean(rm),
    avg_G       = mean(gm),
    avg_B       = mean(bm),
    bright_prop = mean(gm > mean(gm) + 1.5 * sd(gm)))
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
feat_mat <- t(vapply(imgs$path, img_features, numeric(4), USE.NAMES = FALSE))
imgs <- cbind(imgs, feat_mat)
colnames(imgs)[10] = "avg_R"
colnames(imgs)[11] = "avg_G"
colnames(imgs)[12] = "avg_B"
colnames(imgs)[13] = "brightness_prop"
```
